Flagship PV Tech

TOPCon N-Type Solar PV Modules (500Wp – 640Wp+)

TOPCon solar panels utilize state-of-the-art Tunnel Oxide Passivated Contact technology built on high-grade N-type silicon wafers. Featuring ultra-thin 1-2nm silicon oxide tunnel layers and doped polysilicon rear contacts, these modules offer ultra-low degradation (~1% first year, 0.4% annually thereafter), exceptional bifacial yield, and superior high-temperature coefficients.

Core Technical Features:
Efficiency exceeding 22.0% up to 23.32%
Power output ranges from 500Wp to 640Wp+ (commercial/utility) and 275W (compact)
Dual-glass bifacial architecture capturing reflected rear-side light
Superior performance under low-light (cloudy days, early morning & dusk)
30-Year Linear Power Performance Warranty with 1% initial year degradation
Exceptional thermal coefficient for hot desert & tropical climates

High-Efficiency Grid-Tie Solar Inverter

Grid-tie inverters convert DC power harvested from solar arrays into synchronized AC grid power with over 98% efficiency. They feature intelligent Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT), certified anti-islanding safety shutdown during grid outages, and seamless net-metering integration with public utility lines without requiring expensive battery storage.

Core Technical Features:
Up to 98.6% conversion efficiency with dual/quad MPPT algorithms
Anti-Islanding auto-shutdown protecting utility line maintenance workers
Zero battery requirement — utilizes public grid as virtual storage
Net Metering support for export billing credits
IP65/IP66 weatherproof die-cast aluminum enclosure with remote WiFi/4G monitoring

Smart All-in-One Hybrid Solar Inverter (3kW – 50kW)

The Ekchakra Hybrid Inverter intelligently bridges solar panels, battery banks (Lithium / LiFePO4), and the utility grid. In the event of a power blackout, the unit automatically isolates from the grid and transitions to battery power in less than 10ms (UPS-grade). Features programmable time-of-use prioritization and smart load management via smartphone app.

Core Technical Features:
All-in-One Multi-Mode design with integrated MPPT charge controller
Fast-switching UPS grade backup (<10ms) for critical servers and sensitive appliances
Intelligent peak shaving and time-of-use energy cost optimization
Compatible with 48V low-voltage and high-voltage LiFePO4 battery banks
Smart mobile application monitoring and over-the-air firmware updates

Heavy Duty

Heavy-Duty Pure Sine Wave Off-Grid Inverter

Designed specifically for locations with unstable or non-existent utility grids. Combines high-capacity MPPT solar charging, pure sine wave AC inversion, and generator auto-start compatibility. Features heavy-duty surge overload handling (up to 3x rated capacity) to easily start inductive motors, compressors, and pumps.

Core Technical Features:
Pure sine wave output with minimal total harmonic distortion (THD < 3%)
Wide MPPT voltage range with up to 98% tracking efficiency
Built-in overload, short-circuit, over-temperature, and low-battery auto-protection
Heavy-duty surge capacity (200%-300% for 5 seconds) for motor starting

LiFePO4 Lithium Iron Phosphate Energy Storage (48V / 100Ah – 200Ah)

LiFePO4 (Lithium Iron Phosphate) chemistry represents the gold standard in stationary energy storage. Boasting 5,000 to 9,000+ cycles, it weighs 40-50% less than equivalent lead-acid banks and requires zero maintenance. Built with intelligent BMS (Battery Management System) for cell balancing, thermal protection, and remote telemetry.

Core Technical Features:
5,000+ cycles at 80% Depth of Discharge (DoD)
95%+ round-trip coulombic efficiency with fast 1C charging support
Intelligent Battery Management System (BMS) with RS485 / CAN bus communication
Zero maintenance, non-toxic, and non-combustible thermal runaway safety
Discharge range: -20°C to +60°C; Charge range: 0°C to +55°C
